name: Eroi Senpai to Doutei na Kouhai ga Ore no Iu Koto o Kiite Kurenai
original_name: エロい先輩と童貞な後輩が俺の言うことを聞いてくれない
source:
New teacher Ryouhei starts an office romance with his senpai, and they do scandalous things together at the school.

But then one of his students catches them having sex...
translation:
新老师良平与他的前辈开始了办公室恋情，他们在学校一起做了一些不光彩的事情。

但后来他的一名学生发现他们正在做爱……
